verdict.rationale: Whether an editor or agent product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Cursor's own source is released under an open license. The community mentions of a GitHub issue tracker and of Cursor being a 'VS Code fork' describe an issue tracker and the upstream base, not Cursor's own code. The Cookbook repo contains SDK examples, not product source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
